newsitem.title: USA: Sharper Image names Gilbert vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Sharper Image names Gilbert vice chairman.

text.p: Sharper Image Corp said on Monday it named Barry Gilbert vice chairman and chief operating officer.
Gilbert's post is a new one at the company and he will report directly to Richard Thalheimer, Sharper Image's chairman and chief executive, the company said.
"Mr. Gilbert will have overall responsibility for all aspects of The Sharper Image retail and catalog operations on a day to day basis," Thalheimer said.
Most recently, Gilbert was senior vice president of international operations for Time Warner Inc affiliate Warner Bros. Studio Stores, based in Los Angeles.
